optimizedDescription.value: Delegates prepared project indexing to an open provider, forwarding force intent while excluding storage lifecycle, locking, and host I/O.

optimizedContext.value:
# IndexProjectGraph

## Rules

- `IndexProjectGraph.execute(input)` MUST call `provider.index()` with `IndexOptions` built from `projectRoot`, `workspaces`, `graphConfig`, `codeGraphVersion`, `vcsRoot`, optional `vcsRef`, optional `onProgress`; MUST return `IndexResult` unchanged.
- Forward `force` to `CodeGraphProvider.index()` as complete logical reindex request. Forced run MUST clear reusable indexed contents, bypass incremental reuse, reconsider every selected input.
- MUST NOT call `CodeGraphProvider.recreate()` or perform physical-storage recovery. Provider already open; SDK lifecycle owner handles recoverable open failures.
- `IndexProjectGraphInput` MUST include `provider`, `projectRoot`, `workspaces`, `graphConfig`, `codeGraphVersion`, `vcsRoot`; MAY include `vcsRef`, `force`, `onProgress`. Forward `vcsRoot` unchanged.
- MUST NOT resolve workspaces, acquire locks, spawn processes, open/close/clear/recreate storage, or otherwise own storage lifecycle. Force responsibility: forward intent only.
- `createIndexProjectGraph()` MUST return stateless `IndexProjectGraph`.

## Constraints

- MUST NOT open/close provider.
- MUST NOT acquire/release graph indexing lock.
- Per-file errors remain in `IndexResult.errors`; MUST NOT throw for parse failures.
